scientific_integrity: Novelty is restricted to the exact many-follower nonperturbative strictness and the fourth-order collective defect; the chase-and-run steady law, entropy-production formula, one-follower frontier and generic variational technique are prior work.
scientific_limitations: Rigorous for fixed finite N, positive diffusion coefficients, periodic sinusoidal equal-signed nonreciprocal forces, uniformly stationary phase and the full entropy-production convention. The O(a^6) remainder is at fixed parameters, not uniform in N or weak noise. No monotonicity in N, universal all-model inequality, experimentally finite-precision identifiability or independent certification asserted.
title: Strict collective suppression of transport efficiency in a nonreciprocal Brownian ring
